scores.evidence: Build this before realtime so the sync layer can enforce it from the start.
scores.rationale: Mostly substrate-upward (model, auth, sync, UX, scale), but nothing is proven before dependents are specified and observability/security are placed last.
No thin end-to-end production path first; the first milestone is a local solo editor and live collaboration only arrives in Phase 4.

scores.evidence: For most new projects, use **Yjs** unless you have a specific reason not to.
scores.rationale: Irreversible decisions are listed up front with a default for CRDT, but flip conditions are vague and other choices lack defaults or revisit triggers.

scores.evidence: Build this before realtime so the sync layer can enforce it from the start.
scores.rationale: Some ordering by impact (data model and auth before sync), but later phases, such as features and hardening, are not ordered by blast radius.

scores.evidence: Do a security review: WebSocket auth, authorization on every update, XSS in content, and input validation.
scores.rationale: Auth and permissions appear in Phases 3–4, but the security review and most of the checks are deferred to Phase 9.

scores.evidence: Add observability: metrics for sync latency, connection counts, and document size. Add error tracking too.
scores.rationale: Observability is only in the Phase 9 hardening step, not from day zero.
There is no mention of reproducible builds, environments, CI, or infrastructure as code.

scores.evidence: Handle reconnection with exponential backoff and resync.
scores.rationale: Resilience appears in Phases 4, 6, 7, and 9 (reconnect, offline, rate limits, backups), but not in the early phases.
The plan never addresses whether an AI layer applies, so it does not declare the AI layer N/A.
Later features are sequenced, but there is no explicit list of deferred work with pull-forward conditions.

note: A sensible feature-ordered plan, but it has no production walking skeleton. Observability, security, and reproducibility are deferred or absent, and it has no deferral triggers and no AI-N/A statement.
